notes.title: Level Editor Update
notes.content:
Hello,

A lot of stuff happened and I improved the Level Editor a LOT!

You can now:

-> Play the first Levels made by other people
-> Tag your Level with a Level Type and Difficulty
-> Try out a lot of Quality of Life improvements
-> Explore 10 more Objects to place in your Levels

And much more!

I really hope that you will enjoy this Update!

Best regards,
Mateo (The Developer)

notes.title: Big Patch with a lot of new Stuff
notes.content:
-> New Elements:
  -Shark Switch Field (Automatically switches your Shark-Type on Collision)
  -Bite-Chains (Solid Metal-Chains that can only be destroyed by the Reefshark)

-> Controller Support (XBox Controller was used for testing but Playstation Controller might work too)

-> A LOT of Bug Fixes (Thank you all so much for your Feedback! It helped me a Lot!)

-> Move Around on the Level in Edit-Mode with WASD (Highly wished from the Community)

-> A new Background: The Dark Swamp 

-> UI Improvements and less Loading-Time

-> I made a YouTube Tutorial for Beginners where I explain all the important Basics to get started. It can be found in the Start-Menu of the Level Editor.

I hope you enjoy this new Patch and wish you a great day!

notes.title: Patch 4 (Bug Fixes and Community Wishes)
notes.content:
Patch 4 and no end is in sight :) I will keep my best to improve the Level Editor and listen to your feedback and wishes.

-> Now you can move on your Canvas (Grid) with WASD (Highly requested feature)
-> Bug Fixes with the Minecart Timer
-> Block Types not saving and loading correctly got fixed

Please keep giving me feedback and bug reports! It really helps me a lot!

notes.title: Patch 1 Minor Bug Fixes
notes.content:
-> Canon not shooting Bug fixed
-> Only Player, Enemies and Balls are affected by Wind Force now
-> Closed Door Resets now when exiting Play-Mode
-> Spike Fence can be set to "No Movement" now to diable the animation

Thank you all sooo much for playing and giving me feedback to improve the tool!

notes.title: Day 0 Patch
notes.content: Fixed the last bugs and now I just hope you will enjoy my small Level Editor Tool. Please make sure to tell me your honest feedback. I want to make the best possible Level Editor that all of you can hopefully enjoy and have a fun time with.
